messages.subject: Can Shiny work with Micromap package?
parts:
Hi all
I was trying to render a plot made by micromap to the Shiny application. I tested the mmplot part and it worked fine. However, when I runt he application, it shows Error: undefined columns selected.
I wondered whether it's because I made something wrong or Micromap package is not compatible with Shiny. 

Any help is appreciated. 

Thanks,
Wei 

#PLOT 5 MICROMAP Starts
        output$plot5<-renderPlot({
            statePolys <- create_map_table(USstates, IDcolumn="ST")
            mmplot(stat.data=UTD.diff,map.data=statePolys,
                      panel.types=c("labels", "dot","dot","map"),
                      panel.data=list("Estimation.Area","LandlineOnly",
                                      "p_utdtp4", NA),
                      ord.by="LandlineOnly", 
                      grouping=8,
                      #median.row=T,
                      map.link=c("State","ID"), print.res=600,
                      plot.height=12,
                      plot.width=20,
                      #colors=c("red","orange","green","blue","purple"),
                      panel.att=list(list(1, header="Estimation Areas",
                                          panel.width=2,panel.header.size=1,
                                          align="left", text.size=1),
                                     list(2, header="LLO Proportion for Child ", panel.width=1.5,
                                          graph.bgcolor="white", point.size=1.5,panel.header.size=2,
                                          xaxis.ticks=list(0,2,5,8), xaxis.labels=list(0,2,5,8),
                                          xaxis.title="Percent"),
                                     list(3, header="p_utdtp4",
                                          graph.bgcolor="white", point.size=1.5,panel.width=1.5,panel.header.size=2,
                                          xaxis.ticks=list(-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3), xaxis.labels=list(-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3),
                                          xaxis.title="Percent")
                                    ))
        })

messages.author: af243138515ea54e
messages.subject: Re: Can Shiny work with Micromap package?
parts:
Wei,
Looking at your code, I think your panel.att=list is short one panel.  You should have four panels as you specify in panel.types labels, dot, dot, and map.  However, your panel.att list only has three panels specified, with panel 1 corresponding to list 1 for your label panel, panel 2 corresponding to list 2 for your dot panel for landlines, and panel 3 corresponding to list 3 for your dot panel of p_utdtp4.  You need to specify a 4th list that will contain the options you want to specify for your map panel.  Try adding that 4th list and then see if the micromap can be displayed in the Shiny application.  Besides the introduction guide included with the micromap R package, there is an article in the Journal of Statistical Software (http://www.jstatsoft.org/v63) on the package.
Regards,
Mike
